query: What is Ayushman Bharat?
source: National Health Authority - Ayushman Bharat Portal
actualAnswer:
**Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)** is the largest health assurance scheme in the world, launched by the Government of India. 

### **Overview**
The scheme aims to provide a health cover of **₹5 lakhs per family per year** for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families (approximately 55 crore beneficiaries), forming the bottom 40% of the Indian population.

### **Key Benefits**
* **Health Cover:** Up to **₹5,00,000 per family per year** for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
* **Cashless & Paperless Access:** Access to healthcare services at the point of service in any empanelled public or private hospital across India.
* **Pre & Post Hospitalization:** Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses (such as diagnostics, medicines, and consultation).
* **No Restrictions:** There are no restrictions on family size, age, or gender.
* **Pre-existing Conditions:** All pre-existing medical conditions are covered from day one.
* **Coverage Reset:** The ₹5 Lakh health insurance cover resets automatically every financial year for eligible family beneficiaries.
* **Portability:** The Ayushman card is portable across all empanelled hospitals in India.

### **Eligibility Criteria**
* **Rural Families (SECC-2011 Deprivation Categories D1 to D7):**
  * **D1:** Only one room with kucha walls and kucha roof.
  * **D2:** No adult member between age 16 to 59.
  * **D3:** Female-headed households with no adult male member between age 16 to 59.
  * **D4:** Disabled member and no able-bodied adult member.
  * **D5:** Landless households deriving major part of their income from manual casual labour.
  * **D7:** Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) households.
  * *Automatically Included:* Destitute, living on alms, manual scavenger households, primitive tribal groups, and legally released bonded labour.

* **Urban Families (SECC-2011 Occupational Categories):**
  * Includes ragpickers, beggars, domestic workers, street vendors/cobblers/hawkers, construction workers/plumbers/masons/laborers/painters/welders/security guards/coolies, sweepers/sanitation workers/malis, home-based workers/artisans/tailors/handicraft workers, transport workers/drivers/conductors, shop workers/assistants/peons, and washermen/chowkidars/electricians/mechanics.

* **Senior Citizens (Aged 70+):**
  * All senior citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible for dedicated health insurance cover of ₹5 Lakh per year under the expanded scheme, regardless of their socio-economic status.

### **Documents Required**
To verify eligibility and generate an Ayushman Card (PM-JAY Golden Card), you need:
1. **Aadhaar Card:** Primary identification document mandatory for biometric or OTP-based e-KYC authentication.
2. **Ration Card / Family ID:** Proof of family composition and SECC database linkage.
3. **Active Mobile Number:** Required for receiving OTP during authentication and card download.
4. **Government Photo ID:** (Voter ID / Driving License) in case of auxiliary verification.

### **Application Process (How to Get an Ayushman Card)**
Eligible beneficiaries can obtain their card through the following methods:
1. **Online via Beneficiary Portal or Ayushman App:**
   * Visit the official portal at [https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/](https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/) or open the official Ayushman App.
   * Login with your mobile number and authenticate via OTP.
   * Select your State, Scheme (PMJAY), and search by Aadhaar Number, Family ID, or PMJAY ID.
   * Complete e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP, Fingerprint, or Face Authentication.
   * Download and print the generated Ayushman Card.
2. **Offline at Empanelled Hospitals (Ayushman Mitra Help Desk):**
   * Visit any empanelled public or private hospital and meet the Ayushman Mitra at the dedicated help desk.
   * Provide your Aadhaar Card and Ration Card to verify eligibility and generate the card on the spot.
3. **Offline at Common Service Centers (CSC / Jan Seva Kendra):**
   * Visit the nearest CSC with your Aadhaar card and Ration card to have the operator perform e-KYC and issue the card.

### **Scheme Validity & Deadlines**
* There is **no last date or closing deadline** for Ayushman Bharat (AB-PMJAY) as it is a continuous, permanent national health scheme of the Government of India. Eligible citizens and senior citizens aged 70+ can apply at any time throughout the year.

*Official Source:* [National Health Authority - Ayushman Bharat Portal](https://pmjay.gov.in/)

હા, સુગમગોવ એઆઈ (SugamGov AI) દ્વારા મળતી સત્તાવાર સરકારી માહિતી અનુસાર, 70 વર્ષ કે તેથી વધુ ઉંમરના તમામ વરિષ્ઠ નાગરિકો આયુષ્માન ભારત યોજના હેઠળ આવરી લેવામાં આવ્યા છે.

**વરિષ્ઠ નાગરિકો (ઉંમર 70+) માટેની માહિતી:**
* **પાત્રતા:** 70 વર્ષ કે તેથી વધુ ઉંમરના તમામ વરિષ્ઠ નાગરિકો તેમની સામાજિક-આર્થિક સ્થિતિને ધ્યાનમાં લીધા વિના વિસ્તૃત આયુષ્માન ભારત યોજના હેઠળ પ્રતિ વર્ષ ₹5 લાખના સમર્પિત સ્વાસ્થ્ય વીમા કવચ માટે પાત્ર છે.
* **મદદની રકમ:** પરિવાર દીઠ અથવા આ વરિષ્ઠ નાગરિકો માટે દર વર્ષે ₹5,00,000 (પાંચ લાખ રૂપિયા) સુધીનું સ્વાસ્થ્ય વીમા કવચ મળે છે, જે દરેક નાણાકીય વર્ષે આપમેળે રીસેટ થાય છે.
* **યોજનાની માન્યતા:** આયુષ્માન ભારત (AB-PMJAY) માટે કોઈ છેલ્લી તારીખ કે અંતિમ સમયમર્દા નથી. તે ભારત સરકારની સતત અને કાયમી રાષ્ટ્રીય સ્વાસ્થ્ય યોજના છે, જેથી લાયક નાગરિકો અને વરિષ્ઠ નાગરિકો (ઉંમર 70+) વર્ષ દરમિયાન ગમે ત્યારે અરજી કરી શકે છે અને તેમનું આયુષ્માન કાર્ડ જનરેટ કરી શકે છે.

**જરૂરી દસ્તાવેજો:**
આયુષ્માન કાર્ડ જનરેટ કરવા માટે નીચે મુજબના દસ્તાવેજો જરૂરી છે:
1. **આધાર કાર્ડ:** બાયોમેટ્રિક અથવા OTP-આધારિત e-KYC ઓથેન્ટિકેશન માટે પ્રાથમિક અને ફરજિયાત ઓળખ દસ્તાવેજ.
2. **રેશન કાર્ડ / ફેમિલી આઈડી:** પરિવારની રચના અને SECC ડેટાબેઝ સાથે જોડાણનો પુરાવો.
3. **સક્રિય મોબાઈલ નંબર:** ઓથેન્ટિકેશન અને કાર્ડ ડાઉનલોડ કરતી વખતે OTP મેળવવા માટે જરૂરી.
4. **સરકારી ફોટો આઈડી:** (વوટર આઈડી / ડ્રાઇવિંગ લાઇસન્સ) સહાયક ચકાસણીના કિસ્સામાં.

**અરજી કરવાની પ્રક્રિયા (આયુષ્માન કાર્ડ મેળવવાની રીતો):**
લાભાર્થીઓ નીચેનામાંથી કોઈપણ પદ્ધતિ દ્વારા તેમનું આયુષ્માન કાર્ડ મેળવી શકે છે:
1. **ઓનલાઈન (બેનિફિશિયરી પોર્ટલ અથવા આયુષ્માન એપ દ્વારા):**

**Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)** is the largest health assurance scheme in the world. 

Here are the key details of the scheme based on official government guidelines:

### **Overview**
* **Objective:** To provide health cover for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crores poor and vulnerable families (approximately 55 crore beneficiaries), forming the bottom 40% of the Indian population.
* **Official Portal:** [https://pmjay.gov.in/](https://pmjay.gov.in/)

### **Benefits**
* **Health Cover:** Up to **₹5,00,000 (Five Lakhs) per family per year** for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
* **Cashless & Paperless Access:** Available at the point of service in any empanelled public or private hospital across India.
* **Pre & Post-Hospitalization:** Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses (such as diagnostics, medicines, and consultation).
* **Family Details:** No restriction on family size, age, or gender.
* **Pre-existing Conditions:** All pre-existing medical conditions are covered from day one.
* **Coverage Reset:** The ₹5 Lakh health insurance cover resets automatically every financial year for eligible family beneficiaries.
* **Portability:** The Ayushman card is portable across all empanelled hospitals in India.

### **Eligibility Criteria**
* **Rural Families (SECC-2011 Deprivation Categories D1 to D7):**
  * **D1:** Only one room with kucha walls and kucha roof.
  * **D2:** No adult member between age 16 to 59.
  * **D3:** Female-headed households with no adult male member between age 16 to 59.
  * **D4:** Disabled member and no able-bodied adult member.
  * **D5:** Landless households deriving a major part of their income from manual casual labour.
  * **D7:** Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) households.
  * **Automatically Included:** Destitute, living on alms, manual scavenger households, primitive tribal groups, and legally released bonded labour.

* **Urban Families (SECC-2011 Occupational Categories):**
  * 1. Ragpicker
  * 2. Beggar
  * 3. Domestic worker
  * 4. Street vendor / Cobbler / hawker / Other service provider working on streets
  * 5. Construction worker / Plumber / Mason / Labor / Painter / Welder / Security guard / Coolie and other head-load worker
  * 6. Sweeper / Sanitation worker / Mali
  * 7. Home-based worker / Artisan / Tailor / Handicraft worker
  * 8. Transport worker / Driver / Conductor / Helper to drivers and conductors / Cart puller / Rickshaw puller
  * 9. Shop worker / Assistant / Peon in small establishment / Helper / Delivery assistant / Attendant / Waiter
  * 10. Washerman / Chowkidar
  * 11. Electrician / Mechanic / Assembler / Repair worker

* **Senior Citizens (Aged 70+):**
  * All senior citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible for a dedicated health insurance cover of ₹5 Lakh per year under the expanded scheme, regardless of their socio-economic status.

### **Documents Required**
To verify eligibility and generate an Ayushman Card (PM-JAY Golden Card), beneficiaries need:
1. **Aadhaar Card:** Primary identification document mandatory for biometric / OTP-based e-KYC authentication.
2. **Ration Card / Family ID:** Proof of family composition and SECC database linkage.
3. **Active Mobile Number:** Required for receiving OTP during authentication and card download.
4. **Government Photo ID:** Voter ID / Driving License (in case of auxiliary verification).

### **How to Apply & Get an Ayushman Card**
Eligible beneficiaries can obtain their card through any of the following methods:
1. **Online (Beneficiary Portal / Ayushman App):**
   * Visit the [Beneficiary Portal](https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/) or open the official Ayushman App.
   * Login with your mobile number and authenticate via OTP.
   * Select your State, Scheme (PMJAY), and search by Aadhaar Number, Family ID, or PMJAY ID.
   * Complete e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP, Fingerprint, or Face Authentication.
   * Download and print the generated Ayushman Card.
2. **Offline at Empanelled Hospitals (Ayushman Mitra Help Desk):**
   * Visit any empanelled public or private hospital and meet the Ayushman Mitra at the dedicated help desk with your Aadhaar and Ration Card to generate the card on the spot.
3. **Offline at Common Service Center (CSC / Jan Seva Kendra):**
   * Visit the nearest CSC with your Aadhaar card and Ration card to have the operator perform e-KYC and issue your card.

### **Scheme Duration & Validity**
* There is **no last date or closing deadline** for Ayushman Bharat (AB-PMJAY). It is a continuous, permanent national health scheme of the Government of India, and eligible citizens/senior citizens can apply at any time throughout the year.
